values.note: 44 electric sites (1E-45E) and 14 non-electric (46-59). The DNR's RV limit is 40 ft, tow vehicle included; narrow roads with sharp turns. On ReserveMN 54 of the 58 sites take 23 ft or more (three non-electric sites are 15 ft, one electric 20 ft).

sites.source: https://maps.dnr.state.mn.us/cgi-bin/compass/feature_detail.cgi?id=spk00226 ('Side Lake campground has 44 electric sites and 14 non-electric sites. Campsites 1e through 45e are electric, and have 20/30/50 amp service. Sites 46-59 are non-electric', 'RV Length Limit: 40 feet. Length is measured from front of tow vehicle to rear of vehicle being towed', 'Both campgrounds have narrow roads with sharp turns; they may not be suitable for some large RVs, trailers, or 5th wheels') + ReserveMN FacilityId 903 (58 units: Drive-In 14 at 15/25/30 ft; Drive-In Electric 44 at 20-52 ft), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://maps.dnr.state.mn.us/cgi-bin/compass/feature_detail.cgi?id=spk00226 ('Campsites 1e through 45e are electric, and have 20/30/50 amp service'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://maps.dnr.state.mn.us/cgi-bin/compass/feature_detail.cgi?id=spk00226 (sanitation: 'Showers ... Seasonal', 'Dump Station ... Seasonal'; seasonal update: 'Flush toilets are off for the season. Water and toilets will be turned back on May 11, 2027'), read 2026-11-11

note: Side Lake campground of McCarthy Beach State Park, in red and white pine on the neck of land between Sturgeon Lake (half a mile of sandy beach) and Side Lake, near the beach and boat landing. --Claude

Closed for the 2026 season, matching the stored manual close. Phone found: 218-274-7200.
